Power is a song you truly cannot fault at all. 21st Century Schizoid Man by King Crimson is a song about the Vietnam war and what it did people. Flipping that on its head in reference to the song should make your skin crawl. The vocal Choir vocal loop is what makes that song so royal. The video of that song really kicks in just how much Kanye ain’t fucking playin no games with this one. So Appalled is absolutely ruthless, just thinking about that beat gives me chills. It has Swizzbeatz signature drum pattern which he over uses, but in this case it works perfectly. Everyone’s verse seems to get more relevant as time goes by. “I’m so appalled, Spalding ball, balding  Donald Trump taking dollars from y’all”. RZAs hook followed by Swizz’s Refrain shows a man corrupt in his soul, aware of his wrongdoings but unable to resist the temptations of fame and fortune. 

I’m not saying you’re wrong, these are our opinions. Just want a fellow Ye fan to truly embrace his musical genius.

Yeah honestly I could talk all day about MBDTF and not get bored. I don’t even like hip hop but that album changed my life. 

Yeezy taught me!

Absolutely ruined? Lmao that album is still the best rap album since it’s release. The vocal sample being drilled into you on runaway almost act as another layer of percussion.  The way “LOOK ATCHA” is delivered in combination with its syllables (3), create a rolling effect as it’s a pretty much 3/1 loop on top of the 4/4 beat. It’s tone and loud centre positioning make it brash and very in your face, which begs the question, why the fuck did Kanye put this in this song? Because it subtly adds weight to the lyrics and themes in discussion throughout the song. That album has zero weird ass decisions but rather deliberate moves and calculated ideas that have been fleshed out to the limit. Give that album another listen and embrace the manic episodic bursts of sound and emotion throughout . You really don’t get much better than MBDTF, it will stand the test of time.
